name: Gästehaus Rosemarie
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Rosemarie is an inn in Tirol, Österreich. The house is in a quiet location surrounded by mountains. The region is ideal for hiking and winter sports. The rooms are traditionally furnished and comfortably equipped. A restaurant with regional cuisine is available on site. Amenities include a garden and parking. Guests enjoy friendly service and a relaxed atmosphere.
